description_en: Imports KMS secrets for a specified host
description_zh: 为当前主机导入 KMS 凭据
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost import-kms-secrets-for-host --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --secrets SecretName=secret SecretType=ECS --host-id 1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ImportKMSSecretsForHost

parameters.description_en:
The ID of the host to import the KMS secrets to.

> Only ECS hosts can import KMS secrets. You can call the [ListHosts](~~200665~~) operation to obtain this parameter.
